evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/l/f is final and exposes the Jagex HSL maxima 63 hue, 7 saturation and 127 luminance, with the canonical 6/3/7-bit packing layout (hue<<10, saturation<<7, luminance).
Its exact methods pack HSL, unpack hue/saturation/luminance, format a packed value as %02Xh%Xs%02Xl and convert RGB to packed HSL with the same brightness/gamma and Color.RGBtoHSB calculation.

RuneLite upstream runelite/runelite@b0a10a9c14686f4012eb30865261bbeb3d55af4b contains net.runelite.api.JagexColor with the same final-class constants, bit packing/unpacking, exact format string and rgbToHSL(int,double) implementation.

Exact v308 additionally retains int-returning packing and rgbToHSL(int) overloads using the same 63/7/127 representation; these are compatible local extensions and do not change the upstream-proven class identity.

proposals.note: JagexColor is recovered at confidence 0.999 from an exact v308 behavioral/constant match to RuneLite upstream JagexColor at runelite/runelite@b0a10a9c14686f4012eb30865261bbeb3d55af4b. The upstream source name is provenance; exact runtime authority remains the pinned v308 client.
